# Consumer lag alert was a false positive after topic re-partition

A Kafka lag alert fired but consumers are actually healthy and processing in real time.

The topic was expanded from 6 to 12 partitions; the lag exporter treated the new partitions' missing committed offsets as huge lag, a false positive while consumers were fine.

1. Confirm real end-to-end latency is normal despite the reported lag
2. Let consumers commit offsets on the new partitions (or seed them)
3. Fix the exporter to ignore partitions without committed offsets
4. Confirm the alert clears and add a guard for future re-partitions

Error Details
```
Alert 'ConsumerLagHigh' lag=500k on partitions 6-11; but end-to-end latency normal; lag exporter reading offsets for newly added partitions with no committed offset
```

Tags: monitoring, kafka, false-positive, consumer-lag, repartition
